data.title: About programmes.
items: No. Every guest, driver, vendor and the hotel desk gets a link that opens in their browser.
How is this different from an event on Catch?
An event is one evening with tickets. A programme is several functions over days, with households, travel, rooms and the people who look after them.
No. You pay once for the programme. Guests reply, add their travel and IDs; nobody buys a ticket.
Only the hotel front desk and your team can see them, every view is logged, and they’re deleted three days after the last checkout.
Can family or a sponsor see how it’s going?
Yes, with a numbers-only link: who’s coming to what and who hasn’t replied, without names, phone numbers or rooms.
Book a 15-minute walkthrough. We’ll set up the programme with you and import your guest list.
